note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. Jesus, his mother and his disciples are not portrayed: the wedding is a wedding of today with ordinary guests and waiters, the temple is a plain hall with no religious symbols, and nothing violent is shown (the driving out is shown by its aftermath).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

scenes.principle: A wedding took place, and he and his disciples were invited.
scenes.shows: A bride and groom dance laughing among family and friends at a garden wedding under strings of lights.
scenes.prompt: An outdoor wedding reception at dusk in a garden strung with warm lights. A young bride in a simple white dress and a groom in a plain suit dance together in the middle, laughing, ringed by family and friends of all ages who clap and dance with them. Long tables with white cloths, flowers and glasses stand round the edge. Joyful, warm and crowded. The couple and the dancers fill the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The wine ran short; the need was brought to him: do whatever he says to you.
scenes.shows: At the back of a wedding party an older woman quietly tells two waiters holding empty wine jugs where to go, while the guests dance on.
scenes.prompt: At the back of a wedding tent beside the serving table, an older woman in a plain dress leans close and speaks quietly and calmly to two young waiters in white shirts. One waiter holds up an empty glass wine jug, the other an empty bottle, and they look worried. With one hand she points them across the room toward someone out of the picture. Behind them, out of focus, the wedding guests dance on under warm string lights, unaware. Their faces and hands are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Fill the water jars with water. And they filled them up to the top.
scenes.shows: Close view of water poured into a big stone jar until it stands at the very lip and spills over.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a large plain stone jar being filled from a metal bucket in a sunlit courtyard: clear water pours in and stands right at the brim, a thin sheet of water spilling over the lip. A waiter's arms in white rolled-up sleeves tip the bucket. Behind it, a row of more stone jars already full. The jar's brim and the pouring water are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The master of the banquet tasted the water that had become wine; the servants who had drawn the water knew.
scenes.shows: A waiter lifts a ladle of deep red wine out of the stone water jar he filled with water.
scenes.prompt: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young waiter in a white shirt lifts a ladle out of a large plain stone water jar, and the ladle and the jar are brimming with rich deep red wine. His face above the jar is open-mouthed in astonishment. More stone jars stand in a row behind him. The ladle, the wine and his face are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: You have kept the fine wine until now.
scenes.shows: The head of the banquet tastes the wine in delighted surprise while the two waiters who drew it exchange a knowing look.
scenes.prompt: At a wedding reception at evening under warm lights, a grey-haired man in a suit, the head of the banquet, has just tasted a glass of rich deep red wine; he holds the glass up and stares at it in delighted surprise. Just behind him, two young waiters in white shirts, one still holding the plain jug they carried it in, glance at each other with a quiet, knowing look. Their faces and the glass are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: He revealed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.
scenes.shows: A small group of friends at the wedding stand together, faces full of wonder, looking at what they have just seen.
scenes.prompt: At the edge of an evening wedding party under warm lights, a small group of young men and women in everyday clothes stand close together, all looking at something just out of the picture with wonder and quiet, dawning belief on their faces. One has a hand on another's shoulder. Soft golden light falls on their faces. Their faces are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: In the house of God he found them selling cattle, sheep and doves, and the money changers sitting.
scenes.shows: A plain hall of prayer with rows of wooden pews is crammed like a market with pens of sheep and cattle, cages of doves and tables of money.
scenes.prompt: Inside a plain, bright, modern hall of prayer with rows of simple wooden pews and tall clear windows, the aisles and the spaces between the pews have been crammed like a noisy livestock market: pens of sheep, a few cattle tied to the pews, stacked wire cages of white doves, and men behind folding tables heaped with banknotes and coins set up across the front, haggling with customers. No crosses or religious symbols of any kind. The pews and the market fill the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: He drove them all out, poured out the coins and overturned the tables: do not make my Father's house a house of trade.
scenes.shows: An overturned money table and scattered coins in an emptied hall, as the sheep, cattle and doves stream out through the open doors.
scenes.prompt: Inside a plain, bright, modern hall of prayer with rows of simple wooden pews and tall clear windows, a money changer's folding table lies overturned in the aisle between the pews, and coins are spilled and scattered across the floor, glinting in a shaft of daylight. At the far end the wide double doors stand open, and sheep and cattle are running out through them into the sunlight, with white doves flying out above them. No crosses or religious symbols of any kind. The table, the pews and the open doors are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Destroy this sanctuary, and in three days I will raise it. This sanctuary was built in forty-six years.
scenes.shows: A vast stone building stands wrapped in scaffolding and tower cranes, the work of many years.
scenes.prompt: Seen from across a wide open square in clear daylight, a vast, grand stone public building, many storeys high, stands wrapped in scaffolding from top to bottom, with several tall tower cranes standing over it. Tiny workers can be seen on the scaffolding. It is a plain grand building with no domes, spires, towers or religious symbols. The building and cranes fill the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: He was speaking of the sanctuary of his body, and he was raised from the dead.
scenes.shows: From the stump of a great tree that was cut down, a strong young tree has risen tall in the morning light.
scenes.prompt: In a quiet green clearing at morning, the wide old stump of a great tree that was cut down sits low to the ground, its sawn top grey and weathered. Out of the middle of the stump a strong young tree has grown straight up, already tall and healthy, its fresh green leaves bright in the clear morning light against a blue sky. The stump and the young tree are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Many believed in his name, seeing his signs; but he did not entrust himself to them.
scenes.shows: A huge crowd at night holds up phones to film a dazzling sight, faces full of excitement.
scenes.prompt: At night at a big outdoor gathering, a huge excited crowd holds their phones high to film something dazzling just out of the picture; their faces are lit up with amazement, some cheering with their hands raised. Bright light falls on the crowd from the front. The faces and raised phones are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: He knew everyone, and he himself knew what was in a human being.
scenes.shows: A lake so clear that every stone on its bottom can be seen.
scenes.prompt: A still mountain lake so clear that every stone and pebble on its bottom can be seen plainly, right down to the deepest part, seen from just above the water's edge at midday under a clear sky. The water is perfectly transparent with no ripples. The clear water and its stony bottom fill the upper two thirds of the picture.
